engine.review.memoDropped: Memos in {n} edited paragraphs cannot be written back yet and are not saved
engine.review.memoDropped_one: Memos in {n} edited paragraph cannot be written back yet and are not saved
review.view.markupTip: Inserted text is underlined and deleted text struck through, in each author's colour
review.view.finalTip: Shows the document as if every change were accepted (deleted text hidden). The file is not changed
review.empty: This document has no comments or tracked changes
review.editNote3: Comments and changes are saved with DOCX and HWPX files as each format's own comments and revision marks. Rejecting a format change tracked here puts the earlier format back; rejecting one read from the file only removes its mark. HWPX files do not keep format changes.
review.settings.title: Reviewer name
review.settings.author: Reviewer name
review.settings.authorHint: The name written on new comments and changes. Left empty, 'Author' is written. The computer account name is never used.
review.trackTip: While on, new text is marked as inserted and deleted text stays, struck through (saved with the document)
review.newCommentTip: Comment on the selected text (or the word at the caret)
review.toast.pickText: Select the text to comment on in the document
review.pdf.markupTip: Off: the final text is exported (without deleted text). Comment shading is never exported
engine.review.hwpxReplies: HWPX memos have no replies: {n} replies were saved as memos on the same text
engine.review.hwpxReplies_one: HWPX memos have no replies: {n} reply was saved as a memo on the same text
engine.review.hwpxResolved: HWPX memos cannot be resolved: {n} resolved comments were saved as ordinary memos
engine.review.hwpxResolved_one: HWPX memos cannot be resolved: {n} resolved comment was saved as an ordinary memo
